entities.summary: Florence Ellinwood Allen was a United States federal judge on the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit from 1934-1959. Allen served on the Supreme Court of Ohio from 1922 until 1934. She was the first woman to serve on a state supreme court, and the second woman to serve as a United States federal judge. In 2005, she was inducted into the National Women's Hall of Fame.
